name: homeless
description: A sense that you are in an environment where things are uncomfortable, unpredictable, and you are not really welcome to be there by others.

variations.name: houseless
variations.description: Having no space that you can call your own, return to often, or keep your stuff.

variations.name: spiritually homeless
variations.description: Desiring a place that speaks to your deepest existential self, but sensing that you lack such a space.

variations.name: culturally homeless
variations.description: A sense that you don't fully belong in any particular place, being unaligned with others on language, food, manners, beliefs, or other social aspects.

commentaries.quote: Homelessness and houselessness are not the same. Unfortunate people who live on the street without a house may still find certain corners of their city more comfortable and welcoming than others.
Nomadic people have a broader view of 'home' than those of us that put roots down in one place for a long time. They feel welcome across a much bigger landscape

conditions: A sense that you are in an environment where things are not familiar and you aren't welcomed by other agents.
